page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - AWS SRE Automation Engineer
headline: Cloud Engineer | Python, NodeJS, Java, AWS, Kubernetes, SRE, and Platform Automation
summary_html: Software and Cloud Automation Engineer with 10+ years of experience building resilient platforms, automating SDLC workflows, and operating cloud-native systems across AWS and hybrid environments. Strong hands-on expertise with Python, NodeJS, Java, AWS, Kubernetes, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, S3, Terraform, CloudFormation, Jenkins Core, PowerShell, Bash, Linux, networking, and load balancing, with additional experience in Azure setup, maintenance, and administration. Strong foundation in SRE principles, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, platform reliability, incident response, and cross-functional delivery with clear written and verbal communication across distributed engineering teams.

achievements.text: Built automation for build, test, deployment, release governance, and operational support using Python, NodeJS, Java integrations, Jenkins Core, PowerShell, and Bash.
Designed and operated resilient AWS environments using EC2, S3, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, VPC, load balancers, and infrastructure as code.
Delivered Kubernetes-based services and serverless workloads with Lambda-driven automation, queue-based integration patterns, and container deployment pipelines.
Applied SRE principles to improve observability, scalability, incident response, recovery, and service reliability across production cloud platforms.
Supported AWS migration and Azure setup, maintenance, and administration while standardizing environment baselines, access controls, and operational tooling.

Worked effectively with distributed development, QA, operations, and platform teams, providing technical documentation, status updates, and issue resolution across systems, network, and application layers.
